maddeler.e:
تقترضي (form VIII)
# تَقْتَرِضِي (taqtariḍī) /taq.ta.ri.dˤiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَرَضَ (iqtaraḍa)
# تُقْتَرَضِي (tuqtaraḍī) /tuq.ta.ra.dˤiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَرَضَ (iqtaraḍa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
